subject: International transfer acceptance matrix and onboarding cadence
raw_messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: International transfer acceptance matrix and onboarding cadence

Elena —

Following our call last week I wanted to share a compact acceptance matrix we use to align TIA evidence and onboarding cadence for EU customers. Goal: give your legal and security teams a low-friction path to signoff without a big sprint. Attached: TIA_acceptance_matrix_v1.xlsx and a short playbook.

Key asks from Horizon:
- Confirm which processing categories will be in-scope (PHI vs. pseudonymized analytics).
- Identify any required onshore routing or dedicated-residency commitments.
- Preferred timeline for a 2-week evidence sprint (we can do a runbook + 1 week staging).

Proposed next steps:
1) You review the matrix, mark items as Accept / Ask / Reject.
2) We run a 5-day evidence sprint for high-priority items and hand off the evidence package to legal.
3) DocuSign route for IDTA / UK Addendum once legal confirms.

I looped Kim and Marissa to scope the technical evidence and the onboarding cadence.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships (EMEA)
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: TIA_acceptance_matrix_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
Attachment: Redwood_Evidence_Onboarding_Playbook.pdf (guide stub)

From: Elena Morales <elena@horizonhealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon Health Legal <legal@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 11:04:00 -0500
Subject: Re: International transfer acceptance matrix and onboarding cadence

Thanks, Sergio — appreciate the clear matrix. Quick notes from our side after an internal pass:

- Scope: our initial rollout will include patient-maintained surveys (pseudonymized) and clinician notes extraction (PHI). The latter will need stricter onshore options or strong contractual guarantees.
- Evidence sprint: legal wants examples of log retention controls and subprocessor attestations for caching/KV layers.
- Timeline: do you have availability the week of June 7 to run the evidence sprint? We need to sync with our procurement window.

I attached our legal team's preliminary comments (Horizon_Legal_Comments_20270524.pdf).

Elena Morales
Director, Data Governance
Horizon Health

Attachment: Horizon_Legal_Comments_20270524.pdf (redlines + Q&A PDF stub)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@horizonhealth.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: International transfer acceptance matrix and onboarding cadence

Hi Elena — thanks for the comments and for flagging PHI workloads. A few technical clarifications that will help us pre-map evidence: 

- Residency options: for PHI we can offer onshore processing via Dedicated capacity in the EU region or a VPC private deployment. Both are compatible with the IDTA/UK Addendum flow; the difference is SLA and cost.
- Logs & retention: we can provide tenant-scoped access logs, token-level latency/cost traces, and audit trails for KV cache access. Retention windows are configurable; default is 90 days but we can extend to 365 on committed capacity.
- Subprocessors: our subprocessor map includes short-lived cache nodes and a managed logging vendor. We can produce signed attestations and our latest SOC 2 addendum for subprocessor controls.

I put a draft TIA folder on Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2bTIaMatrix — it has a proposed evidence checklist mapped to the matrix items.

If Horizon prefers June 7 we have a morning slot (09:00–12:00 CET) for the kickoff and can follow with 3 workdays of focused evidence collection.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Principal Security Engineer, Customer Compliance
Redwood Inference

----------------------------------------------------------------
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@horizonhealth.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: International transfer acceptance matrix and onboarding cadence

Elena / team —

Appreciate the detail. To make this operational I sketched a short project plan (below) and a deliverable list we can share with procurement and legal.

Project plan (proposed)
- Day 0 (Jun 7) — Kickoff: review matrix, confirm scoping items (09:00–10:30 CET)
- Days 1–3 (Jun 8–10) — Evidence sprint: Redwood engineers produce artifacts (logs export, attestations, config snapshots)
- Day 4 (Jun 11) — Evidence handoff & legal Q&A; Redwood provides consolidated package and a gap log

Deliverables for procurement/legal
- Evidence package (zipped): logs_sample.json, subprocessor_attestations.pdf, kv_cache_config.txt
- DPA routing appendix and draft DocuSign envelope for IDTA + UK Addendum

Action items for Horizon
- Confirm PHI vs pseudonymized scope in the matrix by EOD May 28
- Confirm DocuSign signers (legal + CISO) so we prepare envelope

We can run this as a tight sprint and Marissa or Laura will own coordination on the Redwood side. If Horizon wants, we can also provide a short demo of onshore routing controls during kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <elena@horizonhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Horizon Health Legal <legal@horizonhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: International transfer acceptance matrix and onboarding cadence

Hi team —

This looks good and aligns with our procurement window. Two quick confirmations:
1) We confirm PHI will be in-scope for clinician notes extraction. Horizon Legal will want the Dedicated EU residency option documented as an explicit contractual commitment (SLA + retention).
2) DocuSign: please send the draft envelope for IDTA + UK Addendum to legal@horizonhealth.com and cc me. We aim to start signature on Jun 14 after our internal review.

We will mark items in the matrix by EOD June 9. Thanks all for the fast turnaround.

Elena Morales
Director, Data Governance
Horizon Health

---
Next steps/logistics:
- Redwood to prepare a dedicated DocuSign envelope (IDTA + UK Addendum) and a consolidated evidence zip by Jun 11.
- Marissa/Laura will coordinate the evidence sprint resources and confirm kickoff time for Jun 7 (09:00 CET).
- Horizon to return matrix decisions by Jun 9; legal will confirm signers by Jun 11.

Attachments referenced above: TIA_acceptance_matrix_v1.xlsx; Redwood_Evidence_Onboarding_Playbook.pdf; Horizon_Legal_Comments_20270524.pdf
